facts.fact: Mais Afrika reports that Guinea-Bissau's National Transition Council approved the Digital Integrity Law against false online content, which sets up a Digital Verification Commission to refer content linked to crime to the Public Prosecutor; the article does not say it has been promulgated or is in force, and gives its date as the publication date, 21 May 2026.
Channel Africa reports the National Transitional Council adopted a law against cybercrime, online fraud and false content; it does not say the law is promulgated or in force.
